verify.summary: {met} of {total} acceptance criteria met, {unmet} unmet, {unverified} unverified; {unexecuted} checks not run.
verify.summary.no_criteria: The contract has no acceptance criteria, so nothing can be marked as met.
verify.reason.failed: A check that supports this criterion failed.
verify.reason.manual: Supported by evidence the agent supplied by hand; the engine did not produce it.
verify.reason.not_passed: Not every check that supports this criterion ran and passed.
verify.reason.trivial: Only no-op checks support this criterion (true, echo and the like); they ran, and they carry no evidence.
verify.reason.baseline: The checks already passed before any work on this task and no file changed since it started, so they do not show the work was done.
verify.reason.tied: Met by a check the plan ties to this criterion.
verify.reason.untied: Met by a check not tied to this criterion: a generic check passed, which is weaker evidence.
verify.warning.untied: The task has {count} acceptance criteria and no check is tied to any of them; one generic result stands for all. Tie checks to criteria in the plan with objects that carry 'command' and 'criteria'.
verify.warning.trivial: These checks are no-ops and carry no evidence: {commands}
verify.warning.baseline: Every passing check had already passed before any work and no file changed since the task started.
